D: Two lifelong mates start a revenge-for-hire business to raise money for a heart operation.
P: Serve the mains when skunks wreck opening night of Don Giovanni.
S: Baked hot sauce wings with blue cheese dip and celery

Oven-crisped wings tossed in buttery hot sauce with a chunky blue cheese and sour cream dip for payback with a kick. Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder and salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once. Toss in 100ml hot sauce melted with 50g butter. For the dip, mash 100g blue cheese into 150g sour cream with a squeeze of lemon. Serve the wings hot with the dip and celery sticks.
Soft pretzel bites, for fourteen jobs in three months

Warm, salty soft pretzel bites with a sharp hot mustard and honey dipping sauce, snacks for the next job interview. Cut 500g pizza dough into 32 small pieces. Simmer 2L water with 60g bicarb, drop in the pieces for 20 seconds and drain. Lay on a lined tray, brush with 1 beaten egg and sprinkle with sea salt flakes. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes until deep brown. Stir 3 tbsp American mustard, 1 tbsp hot English mustard and 2 tbsp honey together for dipping and serve the bites warm.
M: Patty, Swiss, fried onions on rye. Take no crap from anyone
A patty melt on rye with Swiss cheese and fried onions, old-school diner food Pops would order.
Sticky grilled chicken thighs, buttered corn and slaw

Sam on the barbecue while the payback jobs wait in the fridge with the beer. Rub 8 chicken thighs with oil, 2 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Simmer 250ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp cider vinegar and 1 tbsp brown sugar for 5 minutes. Grill the chicken over medium heat 6 to 7 minutes a side, brushing with the sauce for the last few minutes until sticky and charred. Grill 4 corn cobs, turning, and roll in butter. Shred a quarter cabbage, a carrot and half a red onion and toss with 100g mayonnaise, a splash of vinegar and salt.
W: Opera night hot fudge peanut sundaes
Vanilla ice cream, hot fudge, salted peanuts, whipped cream, cherry

Vanilla ice cream piled with warm homemade fudge sauce, salted peanuts, whipped cream and a cherry on top. Heat 150ml thickened cream with 60g brown sugar and 30g butter until it bubbles. Off the heat, stir in 120g chopped dark chocolate and a pinch of salt until glossy. Roughly chop 80g salted roasted peanuts. Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 4 sundae glasses. Pour over the warm fudge, top with whipped cream from 150ml cream, scatter with the peanuts and finish each with a cherry.
K: Rye whiskey, lime, bitters and ginger ale over ice

Rye whiskey over ice topped with spicy ginger ale, a squeeze of lime and a dash of bitters. Ginger ale and lime alone for non-drinkers. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Pour 45ml rye whiskey into each. Add a squeeze of lime juice and 2 dashes of aromatic bitters. Top each with 150ml cold ginger ale and stir once gently so it keeps the fizz. Garnish with a lime wedge. For anyone not drinking, make it with ginger ale, lime and bitters only.

dishes.make_ahead: Toss the wings with the baking powder and salt up to 1 day ahead and leave uncovered in the fridge; bake, sauce and make the dip on the night

steps.text: Toss the wings with the baking powder and salt.
Bake at 220C, turning once.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss the wings through it.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream with a squeeze of lemon. Serve the wings hot with the dip and celery.

veg.n: Dr Farthing's gambling debt buffalo jackfruit wings
veg.make_ahead: Drain, squeeze and pull the jackfruit up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled; make the blue cheese dip up to 2 days ahead. Bake and toss on the night.

ingredients.item: tins (400g) young green jackfruit in brine

steps.text: Drain the jackfruit from the brine, rinse well and squeeze out as much water as you can.
Pull the jackfruit apart into shreds, discarding any tough core, then toss with the cornflour, olive oil and salt.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 220C for 35 minutes, turning once, until crisp at the edges.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss the jackfruit through it.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream with a squeeze of lemon. Serve the jackfruit hot with the dip and celery.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the mustard and honey dip up to 3 days ahead; boil, glaze and bake the bites on the day, best served warm

steps.text: Cut the dough into small pieces.
Simmer the water with the bicarbonate of soda, drop in the pieces briefly in batches and drain.
Lay on a lined tray, brush with egg and sprinkle with sea salt.
Bake at 220C until deep brown.
Stir the mustards and honey together for dipping and serve the bites warm.

dishes.make_ahead: Cook the onions up to 2 days ahead and shape the patties up to 1 day ahead, chilled; cook and fry the sandwiches on the night

steps.text: Slowly fry the onions in some of the butter.
Shape the mince into four thin oval patties and cook on both sides.
Layer each patty on buttered rye with Swiss cheese and onions.
Fry the sandwiches until golden and melted.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the onions up to 2 days ahead and shape the bean patties up to 1 day ahead, chilled; fry the patties and sandwiches on the night

steps.text: Slowly fry the onions in some of the butter.
Mash the black beans with the breadcrumbs, egg, paprika, cumin and salt and shape into four thin oval patties.
Fry the patties in the oil for 3 minutes a side until crusted.
Layer each patty on buttered rye with Swiss cheese and onions.
Fry the sandwiches until golden and melted.

dishes.make_ahead: Rub the chicken and make the sauce up to 1 day ahead, both chilled; shred the slaw up to 4 hours ahead and dress it just before serving

steps.text: Rub the chicken with the oil, paprika and salt.
Simmer the barbecue sauce with the vinegar and sugar for 5 minutes.
Grill the chicken over medium heat 6 to 7 minutes a side, brushing with the sauce for the last few minutes until sticky and charred.
Grill the corn, turning, until charred, and roll in the butter.
Shred the cabbage, carrot and red onion and toss with the mayonnaise, a splash of vinegar and salt.

veg.make_ahead: Rub the haloumi and make the sauce up to 1 day ahead, both chilled; shred the slaw up to 4 hours ahead and dress it just before serving

steps.text: Toss the capsicum with the oil, paprika and salt.
Simmer the barbecue sauce with the vinegar and sugar for 5 minutes.
Grill the capsicum until soft and charred, then the haloumi 2 minutes a side, brushing both with the sauce at the end.
Grill the corn, turning, until charred, and roll in the butter.
Shred the cabbage, carrot and red onion and toss with the mayonnaise, a splash of vinegar and salt.

dishes.n: Opera night hot fudge peanut sundaes
dishes.make_ahead: Make the hot fudge sauce up to 5 days ahead, chilled, and reheat gently; whip the cream and scoop to serve

steps.text: Heat some of the cream with the sugar and butter until it bubbles. Off the heat, stir in the chocolate and a pinch of salt until glossy.
Roughly chop the peanuts. Whip the remaining cream.
Scoop ice cream into sundae glasses and pour over the warm fudge.
Top with whipped cream and peanuts and finish each with a cherry.

dishes.make_ahead: Squeeze the limes up to 1 day ahead; build over ice and top with ginger ale just before serving to keep the fizz

steps.text: Fill tall glasses with ice and pour the rye into each.
Add a squeeze of lime and a couple of dashes of bitters.
Top with ginger ale, stir once gently and garnish with a lime wedge.

af.make_ahead: Steep and cool the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; build over ice and top with ginger ale to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, lift out and cool the tea.
Fill tall glasses with ice and pour the cold tea into each.
Add a squeeze of lime and a drop of vanilla.
Top with ginger ale, stir once gently and garnish with a lime wedge.
